verdict.rationale: LobeHub markets multi-agent collaboration explicitly — 'Auto team formation: The system assembles the right Agents for the task,' 'Write and refine Pages with multiple Agents ... with shared Context,' 'assembling a quant team to execute trades,' and 'My CAO dispatched 50 agents' — indicating swarm/subagent-style parallel work is a real product feature. However, evidence is entirely first-party marketing/docs with no hands-on/independent corroboration of actual task-splitting mechanics, no explicit agent-to-agent protocol spec, and no demonstration of parallelized execution in practice. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of multi-agent task-splitting in action, technical documentation of the agent-to-agent coordination protocol, and evidence of parallel execution at scale beyond promotional copy.
